author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1-v1.5 (v1.5 receipt d9e161a1...8f96). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: when the organism consults its record = its own choice; what it learns from it = new topography and time perspective through SDKP should produce new perspectives.

rule.unchanged_from_v1_5: fresh full look at every need; every reading kept in the record forever; readings within the present 42-day span vote +1 / -1; older readings carry no weight unless re-read (below).
rule.record_entry: each reading stores its day, its verdict, and what it saw in SDKP terms: per-region sign of span excess over that region's own history (Position; 0 if ineligible), span message count (Density), and its three block z-values (Kinetics). Size is generated by the world but carries no information by construction and is not used.
rule.when_consulted: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged: the organism chooses to consult when it is torn, i.e. its present look reads change but the present tally (including this reading) is not > 0. No schedule.
rule.reread: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged: each record entry OLDER than the present span is re-read from the present position. Among the regions the present reading sees as positive, count how many the old reading also saw as positive; if that agreement passes the look's own sign test (p < 0.01 over those regions), the old reading re-reads as 'the beginning of this' and contributes +1. Otherwise it contributes 0 (knowledge, no penalty). Nothing in the record is altered; only its meaning to the present changes.
rule.crossing: PROPOSE when present tally + re-read contributions > 0. Otherwise HELD.

experiments: as v1.5: lambda 32, 128, 8 x 6 families x 300 seeds; probe; BURST b = 5, 8; v1.5 and v1.2 alongside on identical worlds.

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W2_genuine: GENUINE >= 173 at lambda 32 (v1.2) and >= 240 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 5 and DINNER <= 5 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W4_difficult_month: WINDOW <= 15 at lambda 32 and <= 30 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W6_action: macro accuracy >= 0.8516 at lambda 32 (v1.2) and >= 0.8886 at lambda 128 (v1.5).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W7_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.W8_cost: MAIN mean region evaluations <= 0.25 x v1 TERRAIN's (re-reads charged R per entry re-read).

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact counts. Consult counts reported. No change after the first full run.
